modus_operandi.pattern: Dormant entities act as employers and training providers to submit false grant claims
False records are provided when claims are checked or audited
Individuals submit false claims without attending a course
Agents or recruiters offer cash for using credits and suggest attendance is optional
Attendance is recorded for training that did not take place
People are hired only to attend a course and are let go afterwards
Claims exceed the training or attendance actually delivered
A sponsor pays the nett fee while value flows back through the provider
